Uncaught TypeError: Cannot read property 'init' of undefined

I also noticed a 500 response for /session/establish in the network tab (see screenshot attached). Tried Chrome on Mac and Edge on Windows with the same result.

I attached a quick screenshot (invite-link-screenshot.png) and our standard onboarding form PDF (velvet-onboarding-form.pdf) that you asked for.

Ask: can SRE/Onboard Ops look at EDGE-4521 (I saw an alert this morning) and confirm whether the CDN edge cache is returning a stale vendor-init bundle for that invite token? If we can clear or bypass the edge for that path, it might fix the JS runtime error.

Short-term fallback options:
- Generate a one-time magic acceptance URL (single-use) that points to our fallback flow (no vendor-init bundle).
- Create a direct account in the vendor admin portal for Velvet and send a password temporary link.
- If neither is quick, ask Velvet to try incognito and confirm whether they still see the 500.

I have the completed onboarding form attached from the vendor. There's also a DocuSign link we can send once their account is active: https://redwood.app/docusign/VEL-042-contract

Monica — if we provision the account manually, can you ensure PO VEL-PO-1199 is visible to their user?

Thanks — Jordan

Subject: RE: Velvet Supplies — Coupa invite shows blank page / JS console error

Thanks for the report and screenshots — appreciate the quick repro steps, Liam. Summary of what we did: 

1) Verified EDGE-4521: CDN was serving a cached vendor-init.js variant missing the new init function after a recent deploy. Cleared edge cache for the invite path and invalidated the bundle.
2) Pushed a temporary acceptance URL to bypass the problematic bundle: https://redwood-invite.internal/temp/velvet/9f7b6a (single-use, expires in 6 hours).
3) Manually provisioned Velvet Supplies account (email liam.oneil@velvetsupplies.com) and attached PO VEL-PO-1199 to the account so they can view/acknowledge.

Liam — can you try the temporary link (incognito preferred) and confirm you can finish acceptance and see the PO? If it works, we'll send the DocuSign link for signature. If anything else fails, reply here and we'll escalate to the CDN vendor.

Notes: we'll follow up with a post-mortem on the deploy edge invalidation problem. I've added a guard in our deploy pipeline to avoid sending broken vendor-init bundles to the edge going forward.
